 |24=''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" to [[9 ABY]]. "Part Seven: Dreams and Madness" takes place after the [[liberation of Mandalore]], which is the main event depicted in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]" and "[[Chapter 24: The Return]]," the final two episodes of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|''The Mandalorian'' Season Three]].  ||S3=''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian]]" of [[The Mandalorian Season One|''The Mandalorian'' Season One]] to [[9 ABY]]. In addition, {{InsiderCite|228|A Certain Point of View}} also dates "[[Part Seven: Dreams and Madness]]" to nine [[Standard year|years]] after the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] per ''Timelines''. "Part Seven: Dreams and Madness" takes place after the [[liberation of Mandalore]], which is the main event depicted in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]" and "[[Chapter 24: The Return]]," the final two episodes of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|''The Mandalorian'' Season Three]]. Therefore, {{#switch:{{{1|}}}|S3=Season Three|Seasons One through Three}} of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{#if:{{{2|}}}|, including {{{2}}},|}} must all be set in 9 ABY as well.
  |MandalorianAndGrogu={{StoryCite|book=Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Official Podcast|story=Growing Up}} established that the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' take place about ten [[Standard year|years]] into the thirty-year period between {{Film|VI}} and {{Film|VII}}. Since ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Return of the Jedi'' to [[4 ABY]], ''The Mandalorian and Grogu''{{#if:{{{2|}}}|, including {{{2}}},|}} must take place around [[14 ABY]].}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
